summary: Personal fitness trainer with eight-plus years of experience delivering one-on-one and small-group training in upscale studios and gyms, including personal program design, fitness assessments, nutrition guidance, and client retention. Also brings warehouse and logistics experience as a night warehouse selector handling order picking, pallet building, material handling equipment operation, and inventory control, plus earlier retail assistant management and light welding/fabrication work. Brings a blend of client-facing coaching, staff leadership, and operational discipline suited to fitness, operations, or logistics-adjacent roles.
